title: feat(spec)!: an action's description, param helpText and outcomeMessages are {{ }} template slots; ${…} refused at publish
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoBCpS3vE7HS7cD6zZzsAPjZ)_

Fixes #27948

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #28464 (skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md line 23 lists the `{{ }}` copy holes for `confirmText` / `successMessage` / `errorMessage` only; add `description`, param `helpText` and `outcomeMessages`)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：动作的 `description`（参数对话框说明）、每个参数的 `helpText`、每条 `outcomeMessages` 现在和 `confirmText` / `successMessage` 一样是 `{{ }}` 模板槽：裸字符串解析成 `{ dialect: 'template', source }`，`objectstack validate` / `compile` / 发布闸（422）拒绝其中的 `${…}`，并给出 `{{ }}` 写法。平台自带文案（邀请、重发邀请、改角色）和四种语言翻译已改成 `{{ }}`。
- 为什么改：裁决 A（「同意」）定五个文案键统一用 `{{ }}`；第 1 步（#28436）让控制台先能读 `{{ }}`，这是第 2 步：规范收口 + 发布拒绝 + 迁移。
- 风险与回滚：收窄（破坏性）：写 `${…}` 的这三个键在保存/发布时被拒；已存的仍能加载，控制台对没有 `{{ }}` 的句子继续按 `${…}` 填，直到下次保存。解析后的值变成信封对象，所以第一个提交先让所有读取方（core、react、runtime、cli、Studio 预览）接受信封。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts（三个槽的类型）、packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.ts（发布闸）、ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts（`dialogCopyOf`）、迁移条目 packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.action-dialog-outcome-copy-template-holes.ts。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-action-copy-templates.test.ts`，预期 23/23 通过；`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.copyEnvelope-27948.test.ts`，预期 4/4。
- 需要你做的：无，契约复审后由席位落地；HotCRM 的同类文案另开为 objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2384。

## What changes

Step 2 of #27948, ruling 6545229148, letter A. Four commits.

**1. Readers first** (`fcd2e654`). Typing the three keys makes a parsed action carry `{ dialect: 'template', source }` where it carried a string, so every reader that took a string now takes the envelope (claim 6546254270, amendments 6546313079 and 6546830184):

- `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`: `dialogCopyOf` hands the param-collection handler the action and params with `description` / each `helpText` reduced to their text (`actionCopyText`, new in `actionCopyTemplate.ts`); a locale map is handed on for the host to localize. `composeSuccessMessage` reads an outcome envelope's `source`.
- `ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useActionTextLocalizer.ts`: an `outcomeMessages` envelope keeps its shape (a bundle entry replaces its `source`) instead of collapsing to the word "template".
- `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` `summarizeActionParams`: the MCP param description reads `helpText`'s text, never "[object Object]".
- `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`: `description`, param `helpText` and `outcomeMessages` go through `actionCopy` (`templateSlotSource`), so the envelope seeds exactly as the bare string.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/ActionPreview.tsx`: `localize` reads the envelope's `source` and `helpText` goes through it (it was drawn raw, an object as a React child).

**2. Spec and the publish refusal** (`45d5e284`).

- `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`: `description` and each `outcomeMessages` value are `actionCopy(...)` slots with the inline locale map; `ActionParamSchema.helpText` is `actionParamHelpText()`, the same slot without a map (it was a plain string). Describes teach `{{ }}`.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/action-copy-template.ts`: `ActionCopyKey` widened to the three keys, each with its own refusal wording and example; `ActionRowCopyKey` keeps the page rows at their three; three describe constants; module notes on the roots and the `${…}` transition.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.ts`: a registered action is judged on `description`, each `outcomeMessages.OUTCOME` and each `params[N].helpText`; an inline `properties.action` on its params' `helpText`. Roots: `actionConfirmTemplateRoots(action)` for the dialog copy, `ACTION_SUCCESS_TEMPLATE_ROOTS` for an outcome. Every finding is an error, so the publish gate answers 422.
- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`: `ActionLike` types the envelope on the three keys.
- Expression-conformance ledger: rows `template-action-dialog-copy` and `template-action-outcome-message`. `liveness/action.json` outcomeMessages evidence names `{{ }}`. Reference docs regenerated.
- Eight platform-objects identity tests read the parsed copy through `templateSlotSource` (`copyAsWritten`), as their `confirmText` reads already did.

**3. Migration and producers** (`a8f9f1c7`).

- Semantic entry `action-dialog-outcome-copy-template-holes`. No conversion: there is no copy-hole conversion family in `os migrate meta`, and a `${…}` token held an expression (`${record.user_id?.name ?? 'this member'}`), which has no mechanical `{{ }}` spelling.
- Producers: `invite-outcome-messages.ts` (`sent` / `link_only`, invite and resend), `sys_invitation.resend_invitation` and `sys_member.update_member_role` descriptions (`{{ record.user_id.name | default:'this member' }}`), both `permission_set_granted` outcomes, the four `objects.generated` bundles (en regenerates identically; `check-i18n-bundles` in sync), the action form's `outcomeMessages` help (`action.form.ts` + four `metadata-forms.generated` bundles), and `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx`.
- Changesets: `27948-action-copy-template-slots.md` (`@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/lint` minor; platform-objects, runtime, cli patch; ADR-0087 `registered`, FROM → TO list) and `27948-action-copy-envelope-readers.md` (`@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/fields` patch).

**4. Fields reader** (`408466db`). `ui/packages/fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts` reads `helpText` through `actionCopySource`; pin `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/resolveActionParams.helpTextEnvelope-27948.test.ts` (3 tests; reverse 2 failed, the type pin passed).

## Tests

- New pins, each reverse-checked (source restored from the merge base, test kept, then restored):
  - `ActionRunner.copyEnvelope-27948.test.ts` (core): 4; reverse 2 failed, 2 passed (the passing two are controls).
  - `useActionTextLocalizer.outcomeEnvelope-27948.test.tsx` (react): 3; reverse 2 failed, 1 control passed.
  - `action-param-help-envelope-27948.test.ts` (runtime): 2; reverse 2 failed.
  - `i18n-extract-action-copy-envelope-27948.test.ts` (cli): 2; reverse 1 failed, 1 control passed.
  - `ActionPreview.copyEnvelope-27948.test.tsx` (app-shell): 2; reverse 1 failed, 1 control passed.
  - `validate-action-copy-templates.test.ts` (lint): 6 new; reverse all 5 refusal pins failed, the accept pin passed.
  - `action-copy-template.test.ts` (spec): 7 new (parse arms, locale map per slot, refusal names, describes teach `{{ }}`).
- Updated: `action-description.test.ts` and `action-outcome-messages.test.ts` expect the envelope from a parsed bare string.

## Acceptance notes

- **Readers, all five groups** (seat ruling A, amendments 6546313079, 6546830184 and 6547728288): `@object-ui/react` `useActionTextLocalizer`; runtime `summarizeActionParams`; cli `i18n-extract`; app-shell `ActionPreview.tsx`; `@object-ui/fields` `resolveActionParams` (commit 4, `408466db`, named by CI "Type Check UI": `RawActionParam.helpText` is `unknown` and read through `actionCopySource`; a field-backed param whose envelope has no text falls back to the field's help). Plus core's own `ActionRunner` (`dialogCopyOf`, `composeSuccessMessage`). App-shell's `useConsoleActionRuntime` / `RecordDetailView` / `ActionParamDialog` read `description` / `helpText` from what the runner hands the handler, so they get strings and do not move.
- **Left as is: `action-icon.tsx` tooltip** (`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-icon.tsx` lines 319 and 332, `schema.label || schema.description`). It would draw an envelope only with an empty label, and no parsed slot reaches it that way: `useActionTextLocalizer` always fills `label` (falling back to the name), a page row's `description` is not a slot, and `UIActionSchema` still types `description` as a string. Seat ruling: leave it.
- **Reader sweep** at `408466db` over non-test sources in `ui/packages/*/src`, `packages/*/src`, plugins, services, mcp and cli: no other reader of the three keys takes the parsed value as a string. The renderers (`action:button` / `icon` / `group` / `menu`, `element:button`) forward `description` and `outcomeMessages` into `execute()`, and the runner reduces them.
- **HotCRM producers** (carried by objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2384): `src/service/actions/knowledge_article.actions.ts` lines 121-123 and 144-146 (six `outcomeMessages` entries with `${result.helpful}` / `${result.notHelpful}`), and `src/sales/translations/{en,es-ES,ja-JP,zh-CN}/objects.service.ts`. Roots are `result`, so each converts to `{{ result.helpful }}` / `{{ result.notHelpful }}`.
- **`default` vs `??`.** `{{ record.user_id.name | default:'this member' }}` also fires on an empty name, where `??` fired only on null/undefined. For a member name that is the intended reading.
- **Census beyond the stop report.** Three more platform holes than `out/27948-step2-surface-stop.md` listed: the `link_only` outcomes and both `permission_set_granted` outcomes (`${result.grantedPermissionSet.label}`). All on `record` / `result`, all converted.
- **The family's other refusals now reach these keys**: a blank sentence, a single-brace `{x}`, a hole over an unbound root, logic or an unknown formatter. The in-repo census found none; full dogfood is the check on the platform's own copy.
- **Not changed.** `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/role-change-granted-set.ts` line 29 still names `${result.grantedPermissionSet.label}` in a comment (outside the surface). The ui console pin `ActionParamDialog.invitationScreens-27521.test.tsx` carries its own `${…}` literal, which the console still reads.
- **`ActionLike` / `ActionCopyKey` widening** is a type-level change for TypeScript readers of a parsed `ActionSchema`; the changeset names `templateSlotSource` as the reader.
